import urllib.request,json
url='https://api.github.com/repos/mruby/mruby/commits?path=mrbgems/mruby-compiler/core/codegen.c&sha=master&until=2026-08-15T00:00:00Z&per_page=100'
req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'openhands'})
data=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30))
for c in data:
 msg=c['commit']['message'].split('\n')[0]
 if any(w in msg.lower() for w in ['overflow','dispatch','jmp','jump','oob','buffer','fix']):
  print(c['sha'][:12], c['commit']['author']['date'][:10], msg)
